outputs.description: Research Brief 3.0.0. comparison_status quantitative requires a nonnull {comparator,reference,factor,offset} and unit. baseline means treatment comparator (factor * baseline + offset), with positive dimensionless factor; constant means treatment comparator offset with factor zero. Offset uses the target unit. Five percentage points above baseline is factor 1 and offset 5 in percentage points (0.05 in fraction), never factor 1.05. qualitative means no quantitative threshold and null comparison. unsupported means an explicit quantitative target cannot be faithfully normalized: comparison is null and a blocking unresolved item names its target ID and exact affected field with a reason. Unsupported mandatory targets never advance. These fixed field meanings grant no source lookup, protocol choice or authority to change a user target.
